messages.text: Let’s shorten the Endcap toroidal to make wheel fit

I’ll shorten each endcap toroid by moving its inner return outward by 0.50 m, keeping the outer return fixed. Then I’ll fit the full inner and outer wheels, recompute the joint field and magnetic sizing, and produce the new OBJ, shape inventories and paired coverage results for PR #90.

I’m continuing with the repository’s design, coordination and validation workflows, plus the ACTS Spack skill for runtime checks. The 0.50 m shortening is now the selected prototype change; engineering acceptance remains separate.

The Spack registry still flags the updated setup and dependency lock as needing re-verification. I’ll check the installed runtime directly before rebuilding the propagation executable. For this comparison I’ll retain the existing coil currents, so the field change comes from shortening the toroids; I’ll report the resulting response rather than retune currents to the old station positions.

The shortened toroids leave 54.4 mm on each side of the inner wheel. Their longer front frame attachments cross part of the second barrel layer, so those barrel modules also need repacking and clearance checks. The outer wheel fits beyond the rear carrier; I’m extending the field and propagation domains to contain it.

The new joint vacuum field and energy calculation are complete. Stored energy is about 4.60 GJ, and the recalculated cold allocation fits inside the retained warm reservations. The extended baseline map preserves every original grid value exactly. I’m now validating propagation in both layouts on the common launch and field domains.

The candidate has 1,344 chamber envelopes, down from 1,560. Each inner wheel has 12 whole trapezoids and each outer wheel has 24; the middle wheels remain segmented. Full-volume coil, frame and chamber checks pass. I’m freezing these inputs for the ACTS comparison and an independent review.

The shortened endcap toroids now leave room for the full inner wheels, with the rear returns kept fixed. The geometry and joint field calculation are complete; I’m checking the before/after ACTS coverage and revised OBJ files before updating PR #90.

The new wheels fit with 54.4 mm between the inner chamber and each neighboring envelope: HCAL on one side and the toroid on the other. The native scans each found one track that reaches the step limit; I’m auditing those cases and retaining them as unresolved in the coverage bounds.

The revised OBJ files and blue shape sheets are ready. The endcaps now use 8 shape families instead of 18. The before/after coverage results are also retained, but field-mask interruptions leave wide bounds, so they do not yet establish an overall efficiency gain.

The geometry and field checks passed, including the complete vacuum-energy calculation: about 4.60 GJ. A separate validation agent is now reviewing the frozen result files, focusing on the native crossings, failure bounds and OBJ geometry before publication.

The independent audit confirms that the two numerical failures remain unresolved in the primary results; the diagnostic reruns have not replaced them. I’m finishing the repository checks and PR update, with downloads for the combined geometry and separate components.

The revised geometry and evidence are uploading to PR #90. The fit is checked; the result remains an outline prototype, with magnetic engineering qualification and coverage limitations documented for review.

The independent review found no material issue: it reproduced the native counters and coverage bounds, checked the OBJ vertices and inventory entries, and confirmed that failed tracks remain in the results. The local project and journal tests also pass. I’m publishing the review record and final PR reply now.

PR #90 now has the revised design and download links. The geometry and evidence are pushed; I’m adding the final validation report and closing the task record. GitHub currently reports no remote checks, so the check results cited are from the local runs.

Updated [PR #90](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/90).

- Shortened each ECT by **0.50 m at the inner end**, keeping rear returns fixed.
- Inner wheels now fit with **54.4 mm clearance** to both HCAL and toroids.
- Added revised OBJ files, shape inventories, coverage comparison and joint field maps. Complete vacuum energy is **4.60 GJ**.

Local checks and independent validation passed. Coverage remains limited by field-mask uncertainty; the design remains a DRAFT prototype.
